senses.en: to allow someone to enter a place or join a school
senses.pattern: be admitted to a university / be admitted to a club / admit sb into the building
senses.example: Only two hundred students are [[admitted]] to the medical school each year, so competition is extremely fierce.
senses.example_zh: 這所醫學院每年只錄取兩百名學生，所以競爭極為激烈。
senses.note: 名詞 admission＝入學許可；入場費

senses.en: to take someone into a hospital for treatment
senses.pattern: be admitted to (the) hospital / admit a patient / be admitted for surgery
senses.example: After fainting during the race, the runner was [[admitted]] to the hospital for further tests.
senses.example_zh: 那名跑者在比賽中昏倒後，被收治住院做進一步檢查。

gsat.sentence: She was then [[admitted]] to a hospital for treatment, where she was able to recover.

senses.en: to make someone feel strong sadness, pity, or sympathy
senses.pattern: be deeply affected by / be visibly affected / affect sb deeply
senses.example: The whole class was deeply [[affected]] by the documentary about children growing up in a war zone.
senses.example_zh: 全班都被那部描寫孩童在戰區長大的紀錄片深深感動。

senses.en: to pretend to feel or have something
senses.pattern: affect indifference / affect surprise / affect an accent / affect an air of
senses.example: Leo [[affected]] an air of boredom, but his shaking hands showed how nervous he really was.
senses.example_zh: 里歐假裝一副很無聊的樣子，但他顫抖的雙手洩露了他其實有多緊張。

senses.en: sudden fear or worry about danger
senses.pattern: cause alarm / in alarm / with growing alarm
senses.example: The sudden rise in fever cases has caused [[alarm]] among parents across the city.
senses.example_zh: 發燒病例突然增加，已在全市家長之間引起驚慌。

senses.en: to make someone anxious or afraid
senses.pattern: alarm the public / be alarmed at / be alarmed by the news
senses.example: I don't want to [[alarm]] you, but there is smoke coming from your kitchen window.
senses.example_zh: 我不想讓你驚慌，但是你家廚房的窗戶正在冒煙。

gsat.sentence: When they saw the room they were a bit [[alarmed]], for it was laid out as a studio.

senses.en: to put or spread a substance on a surface
senses.pattern: apply sunscreen / apply ointment to a wound / apply a coat of paint
senses.example: Remember to [[apply]] sunscreen to your face and arms twenty minutes before going outdoors.
senses.example_zh: 記得在出門前二十分鐘，把防曬乳塗在臉和手臂上。

senses.en: to be relevant to or have an effect on
senses.pattern: apply to everyone / the rule applies / does not apply to
senses.example: The discount does not [[apply]] to items that are already on sale.
senses.example_zh: 這項折扣不適用於已經在特價的商品。

gsat.sentence: In winter, our skin tends to become dry and itchy, a problem which is usually treated by [[applying]] lotions or creams.

senses.en: to deal with or take care of someone or something
senses.pattern: attend to a customer / attend to one's duties / attend to sb's needs / attend to the wounded
senses.example: The nurse said she would [[attend]] to the injured cyclist as soon as she finished with another patient.
senses.example_zh: 護士說，她一忙完另一位病人，就會過來照料那位受傷的單車騎士。
senses.note: 與 to 連用；及物 attend a patient＝看護病人

gsat.sentence: Many of his works—depictions of children at play and in school, farm girls [[attending]] to their work, hunters and their prey—have become classic images of nineteenth-century American life.
Dooley keeps Peanuts company while the adults in the family [[attend]] to Grandfather.

senses.en: very cheap; low in price
senses.pattern: a budget airline / a budget hotel / budget travelers
senses.example: Many college students fly with [[budget]] airlines to save money for food and sightseeing.
senses.example_zh: 許多大學生搭乘廉價航空，好把錢省下來吃東西和觀光。

senses.en: to plan carefully how to use money or time
senses.pattern: budget your money / budget your time / budget $200 for food
senses.example: Living alone for the first time, Kevin had to learn to [[budget]] his monthly allowance carefully.
senses.example_zh: 第一次獨自生活，凱文必須學會仔細規劃每月的零用錢。

gsat.sentence: But learning to [[budget]] your money is the first lesson you must learn to be independent.

senses.en: a group of shops or hotels owned by one company
senses.pattern: a hotel chain / a fast-food chain / a chain of supermarkets
senses.example: The coffee [[chain]] plans to open thirty new shops near schools and train stations next year.
senses.example_zh: 這家咖啡連鎖店計畫明年在學校和車站附近開設三十家新門市。

senses.en: a series of connected events or things
senses.pattern: a chain of events / the food chain / a mountain chain / a supply chain
senses.example: A single careless post online set off a [[chain]] of events that nobody could stop.
senses.example_zh: 網路上一則不小心的貼文引發了一連串誰也阻止不了的事件。

gsat.sentence: [[Chains]] have emerged in Taiwan, Singapore, and even on resort islands like Bali.
Desalinating seawater may kill some sea creatures and disturb the food [[chain]].

senses.en: to question whether something is true, right, or legal
senses.pattern: challenge a decision / challenge an assumption / challenge a claim / challenge sb's authority
senses.example: Recent studies have [[challenged]] the long-held belief that students learn best by reading a text again and again.
senses.example_zh: 近來的研究質疑了一個長久以來的看法：學生靠反覆閱讀課文學得最好。

gsat.sentence: To [[challenge]] the current legal alcohol limit for drivers in the United States.

senses.en: plates, cups, and bowls made of fine white clay
senses.pattern: fine china / a china cup / a set of china / bone china
senses.example: Grandma only takes out her best [[china]] when important guests come to dinner.
senses.example_zh: 奶奶只有在貴客來吃晚餐時，才會拿出她最好的瓷器。
senses.note: 小寫、不可數；大寫 China 才指中國

senses.en: polite in a formal way, though not friendly
senses.pattern: be civil to someone / a civil conversation / remain civil
senses.example: The two rivals disliked each other, but they managed to stay [[civil]] throughout the debate.
senses.example_zh: 這兩名對手互相看不順眼，但整場辯論中仍設法保持客氣。

senses.en: relating to private legal disputes, not crimes
senses.pattern: civil law / a civil case / a civil court / a civil lawsuit
senses.example: Because no crime was involved, the argument over the unpaid rent was settled in a [[civil]] court.
senses.example_zh: 由於不涉及犯罪，這場積欠房租的糾紛是在民事法庭解決的。

senses.en: a group of buildings designed for a particular purpose
senses.pattern: a sports complex / a shopping complex / an apartment complex
senses.example: The city plans to build a sports [[complex]] with a swimming pool and two basketball courts.
senses.example_zh: 市府計畫興建一座運動綜合設施，內有游泳池和兩座籃球場。

senses.en: a lasting worry or fear about something
senses.pattern: an inferiority complex / have a complex about / a guilt complex
senses.example: Teased about his height for years, Tim developed a [[complex]] about being short.
senses.example_zh: 多年來因身高被取笑，提姆對自己個子矮產生了情結。

senses.en: to eat or drink something
senses.pattern: consume alcohol / consume calories / consume too much sugar
senses.example: Doctors advise adults to [[consume]] less sugar and at least five servings of vegetables a day.
senses.example_zh: 醫生建議成人少攝取糖分，並且每天至少吃五份蔬菜。

senses.en: (of a feeling) to fill someone's mind completely
senses.pattern: be consumed by guilt / be consumed with jealousy / be consumed by fear
senses.example: After the accident, he was [[consumed]] by guilt and could hardly sleep at night.
senses.example_zh: 意外發生後，他被愧疚感吞噬，夜裡幾乎無法入睡。

gsat.sentence: Today, tea can be drunk at any time of the day, and accounts for over two-fifths of all beverages [[consumed]] in Britain—with the exception of water.
However, alcohol could not be detected for any of the drinks if the test was given 15 minutes after the drink was [[consumed]].

senses.en: to become clear to someone after a while
senses.pattern: dawn on sb / it dawned on me that / the truth dawned
senses.example: Only when the bill arrived did it [[dawn]] on us how expensive the restaurant really was.
senses.example_zh: 直到帳單送來，我們才恍然大悟，這家餐廳原來這麼貴。
senses.note: 常用句型 It dawned on sb that…

senses.en: the beginning of a new period or development
senses.pattern: the dawn of civilization / the dawn of a new era / since the dawn of time
senses.example: The invention of the printing press marked the [[dawn]] of a new age of learning in Europe.
senses.example_zh: 印刷機的發明，代表歐洲求知新時代的開端。

senses.en: instructions for doing something or getting somewhere
senses.pattern: follow the directions / read the directions / ask for directions
senses.example: Read the [[directions]] on the bottle carefully before you give the medicine to a child.
senses.example_zh: 讓孩子服藥之前，請仔細閱讀瓶身上的使用說明。

senses.en: control or guidance of people or an activity
senses.pattern: under the direction of / under someone's direction / artistic direction
senses.example: Under the [[direction]] of Ms. Lin, the school choir won first prize in the national contest.
senses.example_zh: 在林老師的指導下，學校合唱團在全國比賽中奪得第一名。

gsat.sentence: They are often given a checklist that provides [[directions]] on what to observe or look out for to ensure consistency.
Sorry for being late. Someone gave me faulty [[directions]] and I got totally lost.

senses.en: to use a method, skill, or tool
senses.pattern: employ a method / employ a strategy / employ a technique
senses.example: The detective [[employed]] a clever trick to make the thief reveal where the painting was hidden.
senses.example_zh: 偵探運用了一個巧妙的計策，讓小偷說出畫藏在哪裡。

gsat.sentence: Different methods have been [[employed]] by economists to measure standard of living.

senses.en: having the ability or strength needed for something
senses.pattern: be equal to the task / equal to the challenge / prove equal to the job
senses.example: Though new to the job, Maria proved [[equal]] to the task of managing the whole team.
senses.example_zh: 瑪麗亞雖然是新手，卻證明自己能勝任管理整個團隊的工作。
senses.note: 固定搭配 be equal to＋名詞／V-ing

senses.en: to be as good as someone or something else
senses.pattern: equal sth in beauty / equal a record / no one can equal sb
senses.example: Few modern buildings can [[equal]] the old temple in beauty and fine detail.
senses.example_zh: 很少有現代建築在美感和精細程度上比得上這座古廟。
senses.note: 名詞 equal＝同等的人；have no equal 無與倫比

senses.en: to demand and get something, often by force
senses.pattern: exact a price / exact revenge on sb / exact a promise from sb
senses.example: The long drought [[exacted]] a heavy price from farmers, who lost most of their crops.
senses.example_zh: 長期乾旱迫使農民付出慘痛代價，他們損失了大部分的作物。

senses.en: a particular way of doing something
senses.pattern: in a similar fashion / in an orderly fashion / in a timely fashion / in this fashion
senses.example: When the fire alarm rang, the students left the building in an orderly [[fashion]].
senses.example_zh: 火災警報響起時，學生們以井然有序的方式離開大樓。
senses.note: 常用 in a(n) + adj. + fashion

senses.en: to make or shape something, especially by hand
senses.pattern: fashion A from B / fashion A out of B / fashion A into B
senses.example: The villagers [[fashioned]] simple boats out of bamboo and old plastic bottles.
senses.example_zh: 村民用竹子和舊寶特瓶製作出簡易的小船。

senses.en: to officially end a ban or restriction
senses.pattern: lift a ban / lift restrictions / lift sanctions / lift a curfew
senses.example: City officials [[lifted]] the water restrictions as soon as heavy rain filled the reservoirs again.
senses.example_zh: 大雨一讓水庫再度蓄滿，市府官員就解除了用水限制。

senses.en: (of fog or cloud) to rise and disappear
senses.pattern: the fog lifted / the mist lifts / the clouds lifted
senses.example: By ten o'clock the fog had [[lifted]], and we could finally see the mountains across the lake.
senses.example_zh: 到了十點霧已消散，我們終於看得見湖對岸的群山。

senses.en: a free ride in someone else's car
senses.pattern: give sb a lift / get a lift / offer sb a lift
senses.example: Since the last bus had left, a kind neighbor gave us a [[lift]] to the station.
senses.example_zh: 由於末班公車已經開走，一位好心的鄰居讓我們搭便車到車站。
senses.note: 英式用法；英式 lift 另指「電梯」

senses.en: great care or effort taken to do something
senses.pattern: take pains to V / be at pains to V / go to great pains
senses.example: The host took great [[pains]] to make every guest feel welcome at the party.
senses.example_zh: 主人煞費苦心，讓每位賓客在派對上都感到賓至如歸。

senses.en: to make someone feel sad or upset
senses.pattern: it pains me to V / it pains sb that… / be pained by sth
senses.example: It [[pains]] me to see so much good food thrown away every day.
senses.example_zh: 看到每天有這麼多好好的食物被丟掉，真使我痛心。

senses.en: newspapers, magazines, and the people who work for them
senses.pattern: the press / freedom of the press / a press conference / press coverage
senses.example: The singer refused to talk to the [[press]] about her private life after the concert.
senses.example_zh: 演唱會結束後，這位歌手拒絕向媒體談論她的私生活。

senses.en: to try hard to make someone do or say something
senses.pattern: press sb for an answer / press sb to do sth / press sb on the issue
senses.example: Reporters [[pressed]] the coach for a clear answer about the injured player, but he refused to comment.
senses.example_zh: 記者一再逼問教練受傷球員的狀況，要他給個明確答覆，但他拒絕評論。

senses.en: a machine for printing; a business that publishes books
senses.pattern: a printing press / a university press / go to press
senses.example: The invention of the printing [[press]] made books cheap enough for ordinary families to buy.
senses.example_zh: 印刷機的發明使書籍便宜到一般家庭都買得起。

gsat.sentence: In 1476 he returned to England and established a printing [[press]] at Westminster.

senses.en: not liking to share thoughts and feelings
senses.pattern: a private person / a very private man / intensely private
senses.example: The famous author is a very [[private]] person who rarely talks about his family in interviews.
senses.example_zh: 這位知名作家是個不愛吐露心事的人，受訪時很少談到家人。

senses.en: a soldier of the lowest rank in the army
senses.pattern: an army private / a private in the army / the rank of private
senses.example: He joined the army as a [[private]] and became a captain within eight years.
senses.example_zh: 他以二等兵的身分入伍，八年內就升為上尉。

senses.en: to treat food or raw materials to change them
senses.pattern: processed food / process raw materials / highly processed
senses.example: The factory [[processes]] fresh milk into cheese and yogurt for local supermarkets.
senses.example_zh: 這家工廠把鮮奶加工成乳酪和優格，供應當地超市。

senses.en: to deal with data or documents by a set procedure
senses.pattern: process an application / process data / process an order
senses.example: It usually takes the office two weeks to [[process]] a passport application.
senses.example_zh: 那個辦事處通常要花兩週才能處理完一份護照申請。

gsat.sentence: They’re highly [[processed]] and contain no vegetables.
It replays the image back through the glasses after [[processing]] it on an attached computer.

senses.en: to estimate a future amount from present information
senses.pattern: project sales / project that… / be projected to rise / projected growth
senses.example: Experts [[project]] that the city's population will double within the next twenty years.
senses.example_zh: 專家預估該市人口將在未來二十年內增加一倍。

senses.en: to make light or an image appear on a surface
senses.pattern: project an image onto a screen / project a film / project light
senses.example: The teacher [[projected]] the map onto the wall so that everyone could see it.
senses.example_zh: 老師把地圖投射在牆上，讓每個人都看得到。

senses.en: signs that someone or something will be successful
senses.pattern: show promise / hold promise / full of promise / a writer of great promise
senses.example: Early tests suggest that the new vaccine holds real [[promise]], but more research is still needed.
senses.example_zh: 初期試驗顯示這款新疫苗很有潛力，但仍需更多研究。

senses.en: to show signs that something is likely to happen
senses.pattern: promise to be / promise rain / promise a good harvest
senses.example: With three former champions competing, tonight's final [[promises]] to be an exciting match.
senses.example_zh: 有三位前冠軍參賽，今晚的決賽可望成為一場精采的比賽。
senses.note: 常用 promise to be＋形容詞／名詞

senses.en: a quality or characteristic of a substance
senses.pattern: physical properties / chemical properties / healing properties / the properties of metals
senses.example: One useful [[property]] of copper is that it conducts electricity extremely well.
senses.example_zh: 銅有一項實用的特性，就是導電性極佳。

senses.en: land and the buildings on it
senses.pattern: private property / property prices / buy a property / the property market
senses.example: Prices of [[property]] near the new subway station have doubled in the past five years.
senses.example_zh: 新捷運站附近的房地產價格在過去五年間翻了一倍。

gsat.sentence: Other researchers believe it was because onions were known for their special curative [[properties]], which would be helpful in the afterlife.

The economic crisis may have also played a role: Homeowners who were not able to pay their bank loans were forced to abandon their [[properties]], sometimes leaving behind swimming pools that made excellent mosquito breeding grounds.

senses.en: to try a small amount of food or an activity
senses.pattern: sample local food / sample the wine / sample a dish / sample the nightlife
senses.example: Visitors to the night market can [[sample]] dozens of local snacks without spending much money.
senses.example_zh: 逛夜市的遊客不用花太多錢，就能品嚐數十種在地小吃。

senses.en: to question or test part of a group
senses.pattern: sample 500 students / be randomly sampled / of those sampled
senses.example: The researchers [[sampled]] two thousand teenagers across the country to learn about their sleeping habits.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員對全國兩千名青少年進行抽樣調查，以了解他們的睡眠習慣。

senses.en: carefully chosen; open only to a small special group
senses.pattern: a select group / a select few / a select club
senses.example: Only a [[select]] few students were invited to have lunch with the visiting scientist.
senses.example_zh: 只有少數精挑細選的學生受邀與來訪的科學家共進午餐。

senses.en: to be a sign that something exists or will happen
senses.pattern: signal a change / signal the end of sth / signal the start of sth / signal one's intention
senses.example: A cough that lasts for weeks may [[signal]] a more serious problem and should be checked by a doctor.
senses.example_zh: 持續數週的咳嗽可能預示更嚴重的問題，應該請醫生檢查。

gsat.sentence: Different colors are used in different industries to [[signal]] the roles of people on site.

senses.en: happening without problems or sudden movements
senses.pattern: a smooth flight / a smooth transition / a smooth start
senses.example: Thanks to careful planning, the move to the new campus was surprisingly [[smooth]].
senses.example_zh: 多虧事前仔細規劃，搬遷到新校區的過程出乎意料地順利。

senses.en: to remove problems and make something easier
senses.pattern: smooth the way for / smooth the path to / smooth over differences
senses.example: The exchange program helped [[smooth]] the way for closer ties between the two schools.
senses.example_zh: 這項交換計畫有助於消除障礙，為兩校更緊密的關係鋪路。

gsat.sentence: Normally, the birds enjoy a [[smooth]] flight together as a group when “commuting” between two locations, such as from their nesting site to their feeding ground.

senses.en: a person, especially in negative statements
senses.pattern: not a soul / not tell a soul / a kind soul
senses.example: At six in the morning there was not a [[soul]] on the beach except one old fisherman.
senses.example_zh: 清晨六點，海灘上除了一位老漁夫之外，一個人也沒有。

gsat.sentence: I didn’t know a [[soul]] in the city.

senses.en: to wear or show something in a noticeable way
senses.pattern: sport a beard / sport a new haircut / sport a red tie
senses.example: My uncle came back from vacation [[sporting]] a thick beard and a bright Hawaiian shirt.
senses.example_zh: 我叔叔度假回來時留著濃密的鬍子，還穿著一件鮮豔的夏威夷衫。

senses.en: someone who stays cheerful when losing or teased
senses.pattern: a good sport / be a sport / a bad sport
senses.example: Jenny lost every round of the game, but she was a good [[sport]] and congratulated the winners.
senses.example_zh: 珍妮每一局都輸了，但她是個輸得起的人，還向贏家道賀。
senses.note: 常用 a good sport；反義 a bad sport

senses.en: to emphasize a fact, idea, or point
senses.pattern: stress the importance of / stress the need for / stress that / stress the point
senses.example: The coach [[stressed]] that teamwork matters more than any single player's talent.
senses.example_zh: 教練強調，團隊合作比任何一位球員的天分都重要。
senses.note: 名詞用法：put / lay stress on

senses.en: extra force used when saying a syllable or word
senses.pattern: the stress falls on / primary stress / put the stress on / word stress
senses.example: In the word “hotel,” the [[stress]] falls on the second syllable, not the first.
senses.example_zh: 在「hotel」這個字裡，重音落在第二音節，而不是第一音節。

senses.en: strict and firm in dealing with something
senses.pattern: tough laws / get tough on / a tough stance / tougher regulations
senses.example: The city has introduced [[tough]] new rules to stop people from feeding pigeons in public squares.
senses.example_zh: 該市實施了嚴厲的新規定，禁止民眾在公共廣場餵鴿子。

senses.en: hard to cut, chew, or break
senses.pattern: tough meat / a tough steak / tough material / tough skin
senses.example: The steak was so [[tough]] that I could hardly cut it, let alone chew it.
senses.example_zh: 這塊牛排太老了，我幾乎切不動，更別說嚼了。

senses.en: strong enough to deal with difficult conditions
senses.pattern: mentally tough / a tough kid / tough enough to
senses.example: Growing up on a fishing boat made her [[tough]] enough to handle any hardship at sea.
senses.example_zh: 在漁船上長大，使她堅強得足以應付海上的任何艱苦。

gsat.sentence: The recent cooking oil scandals have led to calls for [[tougher]] regulation of sales of food products.
In a controlled environment, these films may actually reduce the negative impact on viewers and help them become [[tougher]].

senses.en: to find the origin or cause of something
senses.pattern: trace sth back to / trace the origin of / trace one's roots / be traced to
senses.example: The family has [[traced]] its history back to a fishing village on the northern coast.
senses.example_zh: 這個家族把自家的歷史追溯到北海岸的一座漁村。

senses.en: a very small amount of something
senses.pattern: traces of poison / a trace of a smile / trace amounts of
senses.example: Tests found [[traces]] of a dangerous chemical in the water from the village well.
senses.example_zh: 檢驗發現村裡的井水含有微量的危險化學物質。

gsat.sentence: One of these stories [[traces]] the cookie’s origin back to 13th- and 14th-century China, which was then occupied by the Mongols.
The territorial dispute can be [[traced]] back to the year 1917, when the two countries were at war.

senses.en: (of light, sound, or news) to move or spread
senses.pattern: sound travels / light travels / news travels fast / travel at the speed of
senses.example: Sound [[travels]] much faster through water than through air, which helps whales communicate.
senses.example_zh: 聲音在水中傳播得比在空氣中快得多，這有助於鯨魚彼此溝通。

senses.en: an arrangement in which money is managed for someone
senses.pattern: a trust fund / set up a trust / hold sth in trust / a charitable trust
senses.example: Her grandparents set up a [[trust]] to pay for her college education before she was born.
senses.example_zh: 她還沒出生，祖父母就設立了信託，用來支付她的大學學費。

senses.en: to give someone something important to look after
senses.pattern: trust sb with sth / trust sb with a secret / be trusted with
senses.example: I would never [[trust]] my little brother with my phone; he drops everything he touches.
senses.example_zh: 我絕不會把手機託付給我弟弟，他拿什麼就摔什麼。
senses.note: 句型 trust A with B

gsat.sentence: For instance, he was [[trusted]] with many secrets in my family and our community.

senses.en: an unexpected change in a story or situation
senses.pattern: a plot twist / an unexpected twist / a twist of fate / a twist in the story
senses.example: The movie's final [[twist]] shocked the audience, for the kind neighbor turned out to be the thief.
senses.example_zh: 電影結尾的意外轉折讓觀眾大為震驚，因為那位親切的鄰居竟然就是小偷。

senses.en: to change the meaning of words unfairly
senses.pattern: twist sb's words / twist the facts / twist the truth
senses.example: The singer complained that the reporter had [[twisted]] her words to make her sound rude.
senses.example_zh: 這位歌手抱怨記者曲解了她的話，讓她聽起來很無禮。

gsat.sentence: We all have grown up with this popular version, but the same fable can be extended with different [[twists]].

senses.en: including or covering many different parts or groups
senses.pattern: an umbrella term / an umbrella organization / an umbrella group
senses.example: “Seafood” is an [[umbrella]] term that covers fish, shrimp, crabs, and many other sea animals.
senses.example_zh: 「海鮮」是個總括的名稱，涵蓋魚、蝦、蟹和許多其他海洋動物。
senses.note: under the umbrella of 在…的統籌或保護下

senses.en: unwanted material left after something has been used
senses.pattern: household waste / industrial waste / nuclear waste / waste disposal
senses.example: The factory was fined for pouring chemical [[waste]] into the nearby river.
senses.example_zh: 這家工廠因為把化學廢棄物倒入附近河川而遭罰款。

senses.en: no longer needed; (of land) not used
senses.pattern: waste paper / waste water / waste land / a waste product
senses.example: The children turned a piece of [[waste]] ground behind the school into a vegetable garden.
senses.example_zh: 孩子們把學校後方一塊荒蕪的空地變成了菜園。

gsat.sentence: In addition, bottled water produces an incredible amount of solid [[waste]].
The cactus’s thick outer layer (i.e., husk), with all those spines, had always been viewed as a [[waste]] product until researchers developed a biogas generator to turn the husks into electricity.

quiz.stem: After the number of new infections had fallen for three weeks, the government finally ______ the ban on large indoor gatherings.
quiz.explain_zh: lift＝解除（禁令）。感染人數連降三週後，政府解除室內大型集會的禁令。

quiz.stem: Although she is only fifteen, the young pianist has shown great ______, and her teachers believe she will perform on the world stage one day.
quiz.explain_zh: promise＝前途、潛力。這位年輕鋼琴家很有潛力，老師相信她會登上世界舞台。

quiz.stem: Although the two neighbors had argued bitterly over the fence, they remained ______ to each other, exchanging polite greetings whenever they met in the elevator.
quiz.explain_zh: civil＝客氣的、有禮貌的。兩人雖曾激烈爭吵，見面仍客氣地打招呼。

quiz.stem: Since we could not afford a five-star resort, we booked a ______ hotel near the train station and spent the money we saved on local food.
quiz.explain_zh: budget＝平價的。住不起五星級度假村，所以訂了車站附近的平價旅館。

quiz.stem: Because of its unusual ______, such as being extremely light yet stronger than most metals, the new material is ideal for building airplanes.
quiz.explain_zh: property＝特性。新材料具有極輕卻比多數金屬堅固等特性，適合造飛機。

quiz.stem: Halfway through the exam, it suddenly ______ on Kevin that he had been writing his answers in the wrong section of the answer sheet.
quiz.explain_zh: dawn＝（使人）恍然大悟。凱文考到一半才猛然發現，自己把答案寫在錯誤的作答區。

quiz.stem: Critics say the judge was not ______ enough on drunk drivers, most of whom only had to pay a small fine.
quiz.explain_zh: tough＝嚴厲的。批評者認為法官對酒駕者不夠嚴厲，多數人只需繳少量罰款。

quiz.stem: In many parts of Asia, the first call of this migratory bird is believed to ______ the end of winter and the beginning of the planting season.
quiz.explain_zh: signal＝預示。這種候鳥的第一聲鳴叫被認為預示冬天結束、播種季開始。

quiz.stem: The outbreak of food poisoning was eventually ______ to a batch of undercooked chicken served in the school cafeteria.
quiz.explain_zh: trace＝追溯、查出。食物中毒最後查出是源自學校餐廳沒煮熟的雞肉。

quiz.stem: Just when readers believe the mystery has been solved, the author adds a surprising ______ that changes the meaning of the whole story.
quiz.explain_zh: twist＝意外轉折。作者加入出人意料的轉折，改變了整個故事的意義。
